Sometimes I even work on creating short videos for our campaigns.
That sounds creative.
Do you like it?
Most of the time, yes. The team is great, and I get to learn new things every day.
But it can get stressful, especially when we're close to a deadline or launching a new product.
I totally get that. I work in customer service for an online clothing store.
I deal with customer emails and help people track their orders or solve delivery problems.
Wow, that must be intense. Do you do that in the office?
Not always. It's a hybrid role, so I work from home three days a week and go to the office twice a week.
I actually like the flexibility. It saves time and helps with work-life balance.
I wish I had that. I work from the office most days, although we're allowed to work remotely once a week.
If I had to go in every day, I'd probably spend half my time stuck in traffic.
Exactly Sometimes I listen to podcasts on the way Actually this one called 5 English is great No way I heard of it too Maybe we should start one about our work lives
Great job listening. Now let's take a moment to go over some useful words and expressions from the conversation.
1. Marketing Assistant
This is someone who works with the marketing team.
They help with different tasks like writing, posting on social media, or helping with events and promotions.
2. Product Launch
When a company is ready to show and sell a new product to the public, that's called a product launch.
It's often a big event or campaign.
3. Hybrid Role
This kind of job lets you work in two places, partly from home and partly at the office.
It gives people more flexibility during the week.
4. Work-Life Balance This means having a healthy mix between your
work and your personal time. When you have good work-life balance, you're not too stressed
and still have time to relax or be with your family and friends.
5 Deadline A deadline is the latest time or date when something must be done When people say they have a deadline it means they need to finish their work by that time 6 Customer Service
This is a type of job where you help people who have questions or problems with a product or service.
It's about making sure customers are happy and supported.
7. Content
Content is anything you create and share online, like writing, photos, or videos.
It's often used for websites, blogs, or social media.
8. Campaign
A campaign is a set of planned actions to promote or advertise something.
It often includes emails, social media posts, videos, and more.
9. Intense
When something is intense, it feels strong or difficult.
A job or day can be intense if there's a lot to do, or if it's stressful or fast-paced.
